independentFirstCandidate.hold: The 681/681 result did not cover a companion Keys entry. The author's old-source negative establishes staging before refusal, so this limited scope pass is not final-source acceptance.
independentFirstCandidate.baselineMethod: Installer and Launcher.cs extracted byte-exactly from base with git cat-file, compiled and executed in fixtures; built API/web apps are linked from the first-candidate checkout. This is not a separate signed-main build or checkout run.
independentFirstCandidate.firstAttempt: Authentic 598 pass / 34 fail / 1 skip at 633 assertions. Windows PowerShell CLIXML stderr was not decoded by the initial driver, so refusal-message checks failed. The final driver decodes CLIXML without weakening product assertions.
independentFirstCandidate.laterAttempts: Intermediate pre-capture and pre-junction-cleanup runs are retained by original hashes/counts and failed assertion names; their evolving totals are not merged into final totals.

limits: No gateway is started and no Chrome window is opened; the persisted configuration and native validation are exercised, not a launch.
Each disposable repo contains only the built files the installer and native validator read, copied byte-identically from the checkout.
Stage detection uses recursive file-system events under each case folder; it is positively controlled by ordinary installs in the same run.

Plaintext scanning covers stdout/stderr and every file under the disposable run folder (UTF-8/UTF-16LE, full value, hex and 12-hex fragments, both cases); Windows event logs and other OS stores are not inspected.

Fixture paths are kept short (longest transient stage path asserted <= 245) because the installer fails compilation when a staged path exceeds MAX_PATH; that pre-existing limitation is outside #437 and is characterized separately.

longPathDiagnostic.establishes: Unmodified-installer breakpoint output records csc exit 0 at a 235-character staged exe path and exit 1 at 236 with CS1567. The next 237-character sample records CS1619. Compile and staging code after the early check is byte-identical to base.
longPathDiagnostic.disposition: Earlier failed ordinary fixture runs remain failed and source-bound. Their path depth triggers this existing compiler boundary; they do not establish a new #437 regression. The final driver uses short fixtures and an explicit path-budget assertion. No new #437 gate is added.
longPathDiagnostic.limit: Threshold was measured on this Windows host. Historical base long-path compilation was not separately executed; prior behavior is supported by byte-identical unchanged code and the current native measurement. The terminal report derives a reinstall InstallDir limit of 168 characters; default installation paths are substantially shorter.
longPathDiagnostic.discardedDiagnostic: One early diagnostic script had a tool-escaping error and was discarded before its output was used.
